scope_statement: Rhythm regularity indicator. Not a diagnosis. Not validated for clinical use. Cannot distinguish atrial fibrillation from other causes of irregularity.

device_domain_gate.reason: No device-domain validation artifact exists. Device R-peak timing has never been checked against a beat-level reference, so no clinical severity may be emitted and MedGemma must not be called. Rhythm verdicts remain available as engineering output only.

output_class: ENGINEERING - rhythm verdicts with evidence; NO clinical severity, NO MedGemma report

threshold_provenance.shippable_blocked_on: no device-anchored REGULAR distribution exists; the ProRhythm REGULAR distribution measured to date is an artefact of R-peak detection error (device windows median RR CV 0.19 vs 0.03 for healthy LTAFDB windows). Unblocks on a controlled recording with a beat-level RR reference.
threshold_provenance.operating_point: Youden; only the REGULAR verdict is actionable
threshold_provenance.ci_method: record-level (cluster) bootstrap, 1000 resamples of 16 LTAFDB records
threshold_provenance.ci_note: Re-derived on 16 records (was 6). LORO spread narrowed 0.0550 -> 0.0125 and the CI halved (0.0752 -> 0.0375 wide). IRREGULAR windows now come from 14 records with a top-2 share of 44% (was 4 records, 76%). MITDB's own Youden optimum is 0.1350, agreeing to within 0.0075.

rate.normal_band_evidence: LTAFDB sinus-rhythm windows (n=15,016): HR p05 63.7, median 75.0, p95 91.1 bpm
rate.extreme_band_basis: ADOPTED convention - NOT derived, NOT validated here

events.pause_basis: DERIVED - LTAFDB sinus RR, 0.0089% exceed 2000 ms
events.ectopy_basis: DERIVED - validated vs expert beat labels, MITDB + SVDB

operating_point.policy: Youden threshold; ONLY the REGULAR verdict is actionable
operating_point.rationale: NPV falls monotonically as the threshold tightens while PPV only exceeds 0.80 where sensitivity has collapsed to 0.13. IRREGULAR (PPV ~0.40) prompts review and must never fire an alarm or reach an escalation desk on its own.
